definitions.explanation: Physical or mental tiredness resulting from exertion or stress. A somewhat formal or technical term compared to the everyday {疲|つか}れ. Also used in medical and material science contexts (metal fatigue, etc.).

examples.japanese: {疲労|ひろう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{溜|た}まっている→溜まる：02067_tamaru⟧。
⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{疲労|ひろう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Accidents are increasing due to fatigue from long hours of driving.

examples.japanese: {慢性的|まんせいてき}な{疲労|ひろう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じている→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{生活|せいかつ}{習慣|しゅうかん}→生活習慣：19568_seikatsushuukan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧です。
examples.english: For people experiencing chronic fatigue, it is important to review their lifestyle habits.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧: tiredness — everyday, casual term
- {疲労|ひろう}: fatigue — more formal/technical, used in writing and medical contexts

USAGE:
Also functions as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: {疲労|ひろう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to become fatigued). In technical contexts, ⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧{疲労|ひろう} (metal fatigue) refers to the weakening of materials under repeated stress.

- {疲労|ひろう}⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧: fatigue recovery
- ⟦{慢性|まんせい}→慢性：09014_mansei⟧{疲労|ひろう}: chronic fatigue
